new_destinations.name: Darwin
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Darwin' city article (See/Do/Eat sections); Tourism NT 'Darwin and surrounds' see-and-do; capital of the Northern Territory and a guidebook chapter.
new_destinations.note: Span 72 km (reach 54 km) holds Fogg Dam (about 50 km) and Berry Springs (about 31 km) as Darwin day trips; Palmerston is filed under Darwin. Replace pins with resolve-pin output and re-check span.

new_destinations.name: Litchfield National Park
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Litchfield National Park' article; Parks and Wildlife NT / Tourism NT page; a flagship Top End day trip about 1.5 hours south of Darwin. Park candidate itself (v5405, 2 counted sources) becomes the destination, not a spot of itself.
new_destinations.note: Eight kept spots; candidate centre is a visitor-understood midpoint of the waterfalls; Batchelor is about 23 km from it, inside the 37 km reach.

placements.name: Aquascene

placements.name: Adelaide River
placements.coordinates_source: photon amenity=police "Adelaide River Police Station"; agrees with wiki
placements.bio: Stuart Highway town about 112 km south of Darwin, base for jumping crocodile cruises and a war cemetery.
placements.reason: 112 km south of Darwin centre (past its 54 km reach) and on the Stuart Highway south route. Score: 7819 views, 2 counted sources.

folded.name: Humpty Doo
folded.reason: Rule: never list a town beside its own attraction; the town is a general store, pub and cafe and Wikivoyage warns it is much smaller than the map suggests, so The Big Boxing Crocodile is the spot and Humpty Doo is named in its bio/description as the gateway to Fogg Dam. This is the one kept place not given its own entry; the owner may override and add it as a spot of darwin.

review.name: Burnett House
review.case_for_and_against: For: architecture of the Top End and a harbour-side stop. Against: a tea room, open mainly Sundays, interior access unconfirmed.

review.name: Lake Alexander
review.case_for_and_against: For: safe swimming when the sea has stingers. Against: part of East Point Reserve, local recreation.

review.name: Wagait Beach
review.case_for_and_against: For: day trip with ferry, beach, WWII gun emplacement. Against: one counted source, local holiday community.

review.name: Howard Springs Nature Park
review.case_for_and_against: For: a recognised swimming and picnic stop. Against: one counted source, local park; Wikivoyage Darwin does not name it.

review.name: Batchelor Butterfly and Petting Farm
review.case_for_and_against: For: family stop in Litchfield's gateway. Against: one source, small commercial venue.

review.name: Tjaynera Falls (Sandy Creek)
review.case_for_and_against: For: genuine swim destination. Against: 4WD-only access and a minority of visitors.

review.name: Walker Creek
review.case_for_and_against: For: good swim and walk start. Against: mainly a campground and trail junction.

review.name: Blyth Homestead
review.case_for_and_against: For: heritage stop with story. Against: 4WD-only, ruin.

review.name: Adelaide River War Cemetery
review.case_for_and_against: For: a quiet, well-kept site of real interest. Against: memorial, 20-minute visit.

review.name: Corroboree Billabong
review.case_for_and_against: For: crocodile-rich wetland a guide singles out. Against: inside Mary River National Park, and activity is mostly a cruise.

review.name: Mandorah
review.case_for_and_against: For: ferry day trip, pub on the water. Against: small settlement, no standalone listing of a stop; consider with Wagait Beach.

review.name: Cullen Bay
review.case_for_and_against: For: waterfront promenade a visitor might spend an hour on. Against: dining/marina precinct.

review.name: Deckchair Cinema
review.case_for_and_against: For: a Darwin signature evening, seasonal venue is fine. Against: it is a screening, effectively an evening event, not half-hour sightseeing.

review.name: Patakijiyali Museum
review.case_for_and_against: For: Tiwi history and art. Against: short hours, reached via tours, one source.

review.name: Garig Gunak Barlu National Park
review.case_for_and_against: For: marine turtles, wilderness, Victoria Settlement. Against: rarely visited and no counted source reached.

notes: All coordinates are DRAFT candidate-list points; resolve-pin.py must resolve every one (trail midpoint for Tabletop Track, which currently carries Walker Creek's point; beach natural/beach for Mindil Beach).
Standalone spots carry country, countryCode, continent, timezone as marked; run build-spot-districts.py for every new id.
Hours/cost/ticketUrl are null with needs_research unless a source gave them (Wikivoyage: gaol, MAGNT, gardens, Fogg Dam, croc sculpture).
owner_decisions: Humpty Doo stays folded into its attraction: the spot is "The Big Boxing Crocodile".
Stokes Hill Wharf dropped (near-duplicate of Darwin Waterfront).
Tabletop Track pinned at the midpoint of its route.
Darwin and Litchfield National Park approved as proposed; none of the 15 review places added (owner did not select any).
